notes.title: Release Date: 1 December 2023
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Nightscape City will be released on December 1st. Don't forget to wishlist game!

There is few milestones that I want to achive. Biggest one is Multiplayer Support. 

Multiplayer will allow you to visit your friends nightclub, design special events together. 

I also want to integrate leaderboards like "King of Dance Floor" which includes all player score on global server. You will try to beat your own score! For now, i will develop these features while you playing the game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2673720/Nightscape_City/
